notes.title: Attention Is All You Need — reading notes
notes.content: Transformer self-attention removes recurrence. Multi-head attention projects queries, keys and values; scaled dot-product attention is the core block. Positional encoding preserves order information.

notes.title: Retrieval-augmented generation experiment log
notes.content: RAG pipeline: chunk papers into 512-token passages, embed with bge-m3, store in seekdb, retrieve top-k and rerank. Hybrid keyword + vector recall improved answer grounding in the lab notebook.

notes.title: Presentation outline: memory for research assistants
notes.content: Research assistants lose context across sessions. Save the researcher's interests, current stage and next goal, then reuse them to rank new papers and notes. Measure time-to-find before and after.
